args.goal: Check for an equivalent completed live-offer rehearsal before doing new work. Use the captured public invoice-preflight homepage and documented private mail and order capabilities to perform one fictional buyer walkthrough from the advertised offer to its documented next step. Identify what the live page actually invites, whether the subject and body route correctly on static inspection, whether a buyer can distinguish a free diagnostic from a nonbinding paid inquiry, and which claims the existing executed invoice checks substantiate. If a concrete misunderstanding or dead end is reproduced, stage one minimal bilingual wording or template correction outside the live tree and verify its link, reverse patch and claims against the captured bytes. Otherwise reuse the current offer and report the actual route reached. Save and read the capture hash, walkthrough and any checked correction. Complete under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep synthetic results, real requests, administrative order acceptance and Treasury settlement distinct. Public changes require host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.
